items.title: Is Visa (V) Trading At A Discount As Stablecoin Scale Grows?
items.summary: Visa has delivered a 65.6% return over the past 5 years. With the shares now near US$361, the real question for investors is whether that price is adequately grounded in the returns the business earns on its capital.
